concerns.text: The plan targets ≥ 80 % power to detect a Spearman ρ = 0.4 (see line 9). With the publicly accessible IBM back‑ends there are typically fewer than 30 devices, which yields far less than the ~44 devices required for 80 % power at ρ = 0.4. This makes the power claim unrealistic and threatens the ability to meet SC‑007. The methodology should either (a) adjust the detectable effect size target to match the feasible sample size, (b) acknowledge the limited power and treat the study as exploratory, or (c) augment the dataset (e.g., include private back‑ends or simulated but validated data) to reach the needed N.
